columns.name: sample size
columns.description: total number of animals or specimens tested in the study

columns.name: host species
columns.description: the animal species that was sampled, as a Latin binomial if the paper gives one

columns.name: virus detected
columns.description: the virus or pathogen the study looked for

columns.name: detection method
columns.allowed_values: PCR, Serology, Virus isolation, Sequencing, Antigen detection, Other
columns.description: the laboratory method used to detect the virus

columns.name: prevalence percent
columns.description: the percentage of tested animals that were positive

columns.name: country of sampling
columns.description: the country where the animals were sampled

columns.name: sampling years
columns.description: the calendar years during which animals were collected

columns.name: study design
columns.allowed_values: Wild-caught field survey, Experimental infection, Laboratory colony, Cell culture only, Review, Modelling, Other

columns.name: main limitation
columns.description: a limitation of the study that the authors state themselves
